scope: Functional translation-factor regeneration, external machine replenishment, whole-constructor closure and autonomy

sources.citation: Mottaghi SS and Maerkl SJ. PURE makes PURE. Nature Communications 17:6756 (2026)
sources.grade: E2 original main Results, Methods, Discussion and publisher reporting; underlying source ZIP/supplement not reanalyzed
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0 article with third-party exclusions; original paraphrase only
sources.achievement: All 36 non-ribosomal PURE proteins expressed in PURE, pooled or single-pot, purified and reassembled into functional second-generation PURE capable of eGFP output
sources.positive_controls: Full PURE and concentration-matched E. coli purified protein reconstitution
sources.negative_controls: Deletion PURE with purification control; subsets titrated and reconstituted
sources.measured_unit: Individual reconstitution assays n=2 technical replicates; separate single-pot regeneration repeated in SI
sources.reported_limitation: Reassembled mixture about 7.6 times less concentrated than full PURE; authors estimate around one order of magnitude below nondegenerative all-36 renewal; ribosomal stock can carry contaminating missing proteins; no pre-registered sample size, randomization, blinding
external_dependencies: Initially functional PURE including supplied ribosomes/tRNA
purification magnetic beads, concentration and separate operator reassembly
sources.unshown: No whole constructor renewal, independently formed/genetically inherited daughter, complete ribosome/tRNA reproduction or multicycle self-sufficient performance

sources.citation: Schwarz-Schilling M et al. Autonomous biogenesis of all thirty proteins of the Escherichia coli translation machinery. Nature Communications 17:1028 (2025 online/2026 volume)
sources.program: Weizmann / Bar-Ziv localized DNA-brush expression with RIKEN coauthor
sources.grade: E2 complete original main Results, Methods, Discussion, statistics and rights; supplement/source files not independently reprocessed
sources.rights: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, not unrestricted CC BY; only original critical paraphrase
sources.achievement: Near-gene co-production and functional participation of 20 aaRS plus 10 translation factors in experimentally prepared DNA brushes; discrete partial functional tests and GFP-HA readout
sources.positive_controls: Selected depletion-factor add-back, individual/group factors, TIRF GFP-HA reporter next to translation-gene brushes
sources.negative_controls: Dummy genes at matched total DNA density; original all-30 threshold trial showed no GFP-HA until added starting factors
sources.measured_unit: Full all-30 imaging n=6 DNA-brush clusters from 2 slides; not 6 independently reproducing individuals; batch experiments at least three separate reactions
sources.reported_limitation: Initial all-30 threshold system failed; 25 nM additional each initiation/release factor and higher initial factor concentrations used; ribosome-derived factors contaminated omission controls; ArgRS needed chaperone mix; technical exclusions, no randomization/blinding; full PURE nonribosome proteins about 10500 nM vs batch ~1600 nM yield
external_dependencies: Prepared surface-attached DNA brush clusters and glass
commercial/prepurified ribosomes, tRNAs, most initial translation factors
externally supplied initiation/release factors, chaperone mix in subset
large reaction reservoir of nutrients and substrates
sources.unshown: Not complete ongoing factor replacement or ribosome/tRNA/DNA replication; no distinct whole constructive lineage

sources.citation: Hagino K, Masuda K, Shimizu Y, Ichihashi N. Sustainable regeneration of 20 aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases in a reconstituted system. Science Advances 11:eadt6269 (2025)
sources.program: University of Tokyo / Ichihashi and RIKEN / Shimizu aaRS regeneration
sources.grade: E2 original main Methods, Results, controls and Discussion via accessible primary full text; supplementary LC-MS/raw runs not independently verified
sources.rights: CC BY-NC 4.0 open original, commercial reuse not granted automatically
sources.achievement: All 20 aaRS functionality sustained in reporter reactions for up to 20 2.5-fold serial dilution rounds; late isotope ratios approximate 1.5 under model of steady replacement
sources.positive_controls: Full PURE translation reference, isotope tracing of aaRS in round 20, repeated 20-cycle condition (authors report twice)
sources.negative_controls: GFP DNA instead of target aaRS DNA; 10-aaRS mixture decayed despite predicted yield; omission of five target genes led <10% reporter by round nine; most reverted optimizations reduce performance
sources.measured_unit: 20 serial round timepoints are not independent organism pedigrees; successful 20-cycle parameter combination reported twice
sources.reported_limitation: Fresh PURE lacking only 20 aaRS supplies the remaining active translation infrastructure and energy/nutrients each round; AARS gene DNA supplied again each round; initial 10-aaRS prediction failed; most other factors/ribosomes/tRNA unregenerated
external_dependencies: New operator-prepared PURE-without-aaRS contains other machinery each round
Externally supplied aaRS and reporter gene DNA in each dilution round
Environmental substrates, external 2.5-fold serial transfer schedule
purified starting system and separate activity assays
sources.unshown: No regeneration of all translation machinery, autonomously supplied templates, complete protein constructor, compartmental lineage or unsupported reproduction

evidence_independence_note: Three project teams are not three E3 replications of one endpoint; coauthor Yoshihiro Shimizu links P42-S2 and P42-S3 and prior EPFL/Maerkl comparator studies are same-program.
rights_copying_note: No paper figures/raw data/supplementary files/code copied or redistributed; critical paraphrase and verified URLs only.
publication_validation_at_preparation: Unpublished research branch: exact PR head and resulting main push CI must be verified before publication claim.
